Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Santiago Chile hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 17 of the 18 Santiago Chile hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Evendo at 5, Super.com at 5, Billabook.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, TravelUp at 2 and Reserving at 1.
